Deterministic, explainable proposal generation over a caller-provided
coherent planning snapshot. Idempotency-Key is required (400
idempotency-key-required / idempotency-key-invalid when missing or
malformed). The body is decoded strictly: an unknown field or
malformed JSON is 400 invalid-request; a snapshot the planner refuses
is 422 invalid-planning-snapshot. 503 problem+json when the
idempotency store is not configured (idempotency-unavailable) or the
pack levels cannot be read (pack-levels-unavailable). 2xx and 4xx
answers are stored under the key and replayed (Idempotency-Replayed:
true); a 5xx is never stored. Diagnostic boundary: production
planning consumes local read models via the simulation endpoint
instead.
